text: じぶんの　ポケモンを　くわしく　しることも　たいせつじゃ！

structure.jp: じぶんの　ポケモンを　くわしく　しることも
structure.en: getting to know your own Pokémon in detail, too

patterns.name: 〜こと (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: こと after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing' in English. しることも = 'knowing, too'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, 'is'. たいせつじゃ = 'is important'.

patterns.name: 〜く
patterns.explanation: Changing the last い of a describing word to く lets it tell how an action is done, like '-ly'. くわしく　しる = 'know in detail'.
